ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:8.title: Travel Therapy Recruiter
ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:8.description: Join Aya Healthcare, winner of multiple Top Workplace awards! The Therapy Recruiter will specialize in cultivating relationships with physical therapists, occupational therapists, and speech-language pathologists interested in travel career opportunities. They will provide the best possible experience for traveling therapists through initiating contact, maintaining exceptional rapport and providing extraordinary customer service. Who We Are: We’re a $8+ billion, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform. At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians, and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally. Responsibilities: Lead full-cycle recruitment efforts to attract, screen, and onboard physical therapists, occupational therapists, and speech-language pathologists. Proactively contact and recruit prospective therapists to establish relationships, understand their needs and qualify them for job opportunities Educate prospective therapists on the personal and professional benefits of a travel healthcare career Generate leads through various recruiting channels, strategic planning and referrals Strive for continuous improvement and career advancement Strong motivation to achieve results and meet recruiting goals Ability to work in fast-paced environment and maintain a sense of urgency Candidate-centered mentality and passion for customer service Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree Minimum of one year, preferably 2+ years, of proven success in a metrics driven sales or staffing environment Obsessed with creating great experiences for healthcare professionals Outside the box thinkers Career oriented with a desire for advancement Enthusiastic about being part of an recruiting organization that recognizes your talent What We Offer: Free premium medical, dental, life and vision insurance Generous 401(k) match Aya also offers other benefits to those that are eligible and where required by applicable law, including reimbursements and discretionary bonuses Aya provides paid sick leave in accordance with all applicable state, federal, and local laws. Aya’s general sick leave policy is that employees accrue one hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked. However, to the extent any provisions of the statement above conflict with any applicable paid sick leave laws, the applicable paid sick leave laws are controlling Celebrations! We hit our goals and reward ourselves. Company-sponsored virtual events, happy hours and team-building activities are always on the horizon — plus, you get a special treat on your birthday! Unlimited DTO — we believe in time off! Virtual yoga, meditation or boot camp classes offered daily Compensation : Aya reasonably anticipates the pay scale for this position to be $60,000 starting annually, plus commissions. The pay scale for this position may vary if applicant possesses experience outside of what Aya reasonably anticipates for this position. Bonuses are subject to the role and your manager’s discretion. jobgether-jobgether:lever:369e5213-a951-.title: Sales Development Program Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:369e5213-a951-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Development Program Manager based in Canada. This is a high-ownership, player-coach role responsible for building and scaling an outbound prospecting engine across multiple commercial markets. You will own the top-of-funnel pipeline, from account targeting and prospecting through qualified meetings and sales handoffs. The role combines hands-on outbound execution with the development of scalable processes, automation, and AI-powered workflows. You will work extensively with Apollo and AI tools to improve prospect research, messaging, sequencing, and campaign performance. Data-driven experimentation will be central to identifying new channels, triggers, verticals, and opportunities for growth. You will also collaborate with marketing and sales teams to develop account-based plays and convert market signals into pipeline. This is an opportunity to shape a function from the ground up while directly influencing commercial growth in a remote-first environment. Own monthly targets for outbound attended meetings and qualified opportunities across priority commercial verticals. Execute multi-channel outbound campaigns across email, phone, and LinkedIn, targeting multiple relevant contacts within strategic accounts. Research and prioritize prospects using intent signals, website activity, job postings, seasonal market timing, geography, and ideal customer profile criteria. Respond quickly to inbound leads, place them into appropriate sequences, and provide sales teams with qualified opportunities and strong contextual information. Own the outbound sequencing platform, including sequence creation, list management, sending infrastructure, data hygiene, and performance reporting. Build and optimize AI-assisted prospecting workflows using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies for account research, messaging, call scripts, and campaign development. Automate manual prospecting activities where appropriate while protecting data quality, domain health, and sender reputation. Review campaign performance regularly, analyzing reply rates, bounce rates, subject-line tests, enrollment, and conversion metrics to identify and address performance gaps. Build and maintain intent-driven target account lists aligned with market conditions, seasonal events, environmental signals, geography, and ICP fit. Partner with marketing on campaign-related outbound initiatives, webinar follow-up, content-led sequences, and account-based programs. Identify and test new verticals, prospecting triggers, channels, and approaches to continuously strengthen the outbound engine. Share sales knowledge, market insights, and successful prospecting practices while helping establish scalable processes for future growth. Requirements 3–5 years of experience in SDR, BDR, business development, or outbound sales within a B2B environment, with a consistent record of achieving meeting and pipeline targets. Hands-on experience with Apollo or a comparable sequencing and sales engagement platform, including building sequences, managing prospect lists, and interpreting campaign performance. Demonstrated experience executing coordinated multi-channel prospecting through email, phone, and LinkedIn. Practical daily experience using AI-powered writing and research tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar solutions as part of a prospecting workflow. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign and sequence data and distinguish between activity, engagement, and conversion challenges. Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to create concise, personalized, human-sounding outreach that drives responses. Strong ownership, initiative, and comfort working in an environment where processes and systems are still being built. jobgether-jobgether:lever:68dfd523-7fe6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Payments Solution Architect based in Ireland. This is a strategic and hands-on role at the intersection of digital payments, financial technology, and quality engineering. You will shape and scale payment testing solutions for complex, enterprise-grade transaction environments. The role combines technical architecture, commercial strategy, client advisory, and delivery leadership. You will design offerings, methodologies, staffing models, and pricing while solving sophisticated payment-quality challenges. Working closely with clients, sales, delivery teams, and technology partners, you will influence high-impact business opportunities. You will also help define the future of payments testing through thought leadership, innovation, and industry engagement. This is an opportunity to make a measurable difference to digital experiences used by millions of people worldwide. Shape the payments offering: Define, launch, package, and continuously evolve payment testing services, including the offering catalog, methodologies, staffing approaches, and pricing models. Set strategic direction: Develop and communicate a forward-looking vision for payments testing, identifying market opportunities, competitive trends, and innovative approaches that can expand the business. Drive commercial growth: Partner with sales teams on enterprise opportunities, participate in client conversations, advise prospects on payments testing strategies and ROI, and contribute expertise to pipeline development. Build strategic partnerships: Work with alliances teams and external technology, payments, commerce, and consulting partners to develop joint go-to-market opportunities. Design technical solutions: Analyze complex digital transaction architectures and create tailored quality engineering strategies for mobile payments, wallets, payment gateways, online banking, POS systems, and emerging agentic payment environments. Provide hands-on delivery expertise: Act as a senior subject-matter expert and escalation point, supporting engagements from initial scoping through test execution and delivery reviews. Resolve complex technical challenges: Troubleshoot payment integrations and quality-engineering roadblocks while protecting transaction integrity, security, compliance, and reliability across markets and payment instruments. Elevate client and delivery capabilities: Introduce new technical approaches, methodologies, and best practices to help delivery teams and enterprise clients improve their payments testing maturity. Lead thought leadership: Represent the payments testing vision through white papers, articles, webinars, conference presentations, industry discussions, and other external communications. Influence without direct authority: Inspire and coordinate distributed, cross-functional teams while building strong relationships with technical specialists, business leaders, clients, and partners. Requirements: 10+ years of deep payments experience , with strong knowledge of digital payment ecosystems such as mobile payments, online banking, payment gateways, digital wallets, and point-of-sale systems. Strong quality engineering expertise , including a technical understanding of API integrations, software development methodologies, and testing practices within financial or transaction-heavy environments. Client-facing consulting or managed-services experience , ideally involving technical discovery, solution design, advisory work, and engagement with enterprise stakeholders. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8339a6c1-582b-.title: Solutions Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8339a6c1-582b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Engineer based in Ireland. As a Solutions Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical and product advisor for enterprise partners across Turkey and the wider EMEA region. You will bridge customer needs with internal engineering, product, sales, compliance, and operations teams. The role combines technical consulting, API integration, solution design, pre-sales, and relationship management. You will guide customers from discovery and evaluation through implementation, onboarding, and long-term adoption. You will also help translate regional requirements into actionable product and engineering feedback. Fluency in Turkish and strong English communication will be essential in this highly international, customer-facing environment. Support enterprise customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle, providing technical support, relationship management, and guidance on platform adoption. Lead solution engagements: Own technical engagements end-to-end, including discovery calls, solution validation, RFPs, security questionnaires, demonstrations, and technical consultations. Drive pre-sales activities: Partner with Sales and Solutions teams to design solutions, communicate technical use cases, support evaluations, and help prospective customers achieve successful technical outcomes. Guide implementations: Lead enterprise customers through API integration, implementation, onboarding, and ongoing platform adoption. Translate customer requirements: Represent the needs of Turkish-speaking customers internally, translating complex business and technical requirements into clear specifications for global Product and Engineering teams. Serve as a product expert: Develop a deep understanding of the platform and communicate its capabilities effectively to technical, business, and executive stakeholders. Coordinate regional requirements: Work with local compliance, operations teams, vendors, regulators, and partners to understand market-specific requirements and ensure they are communicated effectively to global teams. Develop technical resources: Create solution documentation, implementation guidance, product materials, and Turkish-language collateral where appropriate. Support product evolution: Stay informed about product development and collaborate with Product teams to test and roll out new features for enterprise partners. Represent the business externally: Participate in customer meetings and regional activities, with travel across Turkey and EMEA as required. Requirements: Enterprise technical experience: 3+ years of experience supporting B2B or enterprise customers in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or a similar customer-facing technical role, ideally within API- or SaaS-focused businesses. API and integration expertise: Strong understanding of REST APIs, SDKs, software integration workflows, WebSockets, JSON, and tools such as Postman and Grafana. Language proficiency: Native or business-level Turkish with excellent customer communication skills and a strong understanding of Turkish business culture. English communication: Business-level English with the ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed, cross-functional teams. Technical communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible explanations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ownership and execution: Self-motivated and comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and driving complex assignments through to completion with strong attention to detail. Customer orientation: Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to balance technical problem-solving with commercial and customer objectives. Fintech knowledge: Experience in fintech, capital markets, brokerage, securities, or financial APIs

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d417026e-a89c-.title: Operations Supervisor
jobgether-jobgether:lever:d417026e-a89c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Operations Supervisor based in Germany. This is a remote operations leadership role focused on scaling and maintaining a high-performing distributed workforce. You will work closely with the Operations Manager to translate broader objectives into effective day-to-day execution. Your focus will include workforce planning, attendance, quality assurance, coaching, onboarding, and operational administration. You will help grow the operation toward a target of 100 active agents while maintaining consistent performance and reliability. The role suits a hands-on operational leader who is comfortable managing people, monitoring performance, and addressing issues quickly. Strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail will be essential to keeping the operation running smoothly as it expands. Work closely with the Operations Manager to execute daily operational priorities and ensure activities remain aligned with broader business objectives. Manage and maintain an accurate roster of active agents, applying established policies to identify inactive agents and coordinate timely replacements. Monitor agent attendance and schedules to ensure team members consistently complete their required 8-hour daily shifts. Conduct daily test calls and quality checks to verify that agents meet established quality standards and operational expectations. Provide timely, constructive coaching and follow-up when quality issues, complaints, or performance concerns arise. Support workforce growth and capacity planning with the objective of building and maintaining a team of up to 100 active agents. Manage onboarding and compliance activities by reviewing required documentation, communicating status updates, and maintaining organized records. Calculate, prepare, and submit the operation’s monthly minutes-based invoice accurately and on time. Track operational performance, identify gaps, and take appropriate corrective action to maintain productivity, quality, and workforce stability. Requirements Demonstrated experience in operations, workforce management, team supervision, customer support, or a related operational environment. Strong ability to manage distributed or remote teams while maintaining accountability for attendance, productivity, and quality. Experience monitoring performance against defined standards and providing constructive coaching when issues arise. Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate rosters, schedules, documentation, and operational records. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, operational tracking systems, and basic financial or invoicing information. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies, follow established procedures, and maintain accurate records. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with agents, managers, and clients. Proactive and hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the ability to respond quickly to operational issues. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with operational leadership. Results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on team growth, quality, attendance, and consistent execution. Benefits Base salary: $200 per month. Performance-based bonus: 1% of the operation’s total gross monthly invoice. Bonus eligibility: The performance bonus becomes available once more than 20 active agents are maintained while completing their required 8-hour shifts. Growth-based earning potential: Compensation increases as the size and gross invoice value of the operation grows. Target earning example: At 100 active agents, the minimum gross monthly invoice is approximately $84,400, generating a minimum $844 performance bonus. Expected minimum monthly compensation at 100 active agents: $1,044, consisting of the $200 base salary
